name: Muster landing page loads with hero, pricing and download sections

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/ and wait for the page to fully load
The hero heading 'Muster your agents.' is visible
An 'Open Muster' link pointing to /app is present
The pricing section shows a 'Self-host' plan and a 'Cloud · Monthly' plan with a 'Start with Muster Cloud' link
The download section links to /download.html, where the platform download cards are available.
The comparison table with columns Muster, Osaurus, Rakazo, OpenBot is rendered
